title: List and detail panels fed by live deltas
outcome:
test-runs-api.ts, use-test-runs.ts (initial GET, then testRunChanged deltas; no polling), TestRunsPanel.tsx (list, state filter), TestRunDetail.tsx (stages table, first-failure diagnostics, run dir/fingerprint copy, cancel confirm, rerun) per the prototype; sort/columns reuse the Work table conventions where sensible.

REVIEW FIXES (F13, F2): client module ui/src/test-runs-api.ts next to ui/src/work-visualizer-api.ts (preserveGatewayErrorBody pattern); render disk-running stages of canceled/unknown records as 'interrupted'.
acceptance:

- Cancel confirm and 409 rerun message rendered.
- Unknown/canceled/drift/interrupted states rendered distinctly with their reasons.
